title: Zephyr: receiver signature verification
description: Verify SOS origin signature on receive
close_reason: Implemented SOS origin signature verification (sos_origin_verify), signing (sos_origin_sign), transcript computation (sos_origin_compute_transcript), and serialization functions in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/sos_origin.c with header in include/lichen/sos_origin.h. Uses domain separator LICHEN-SOS-ORIGIN-v1, SHA-512 transcript, Schnorr48 signatures.
